All acceptance criteria and requirements in docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are fully implemented and verified:
- Core Functionality & Plugin Structure (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE): - src/index.ts exists and is exercised by tests. - tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts confirm the plugin exports a rules registry, configs, and meta with name/namespace/version, and that default exports are correctly wired.
- Rule Registry & Config System (REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM): - plugin-default-export-and-configs tests validate that rules are properly registered and that recommended and strict configs provide expected rule mappings and severities.
- ESLint v9 Flat Config Integration (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT): - flat-config-presets-integration tests demonstrate that spreading traceability.configs.recommended/strict into ESLint v9 flat config successfully enables this plugin’s rules, directly fulfilling the Integration acceptance criterion.
- Error Handling (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): - plugin-setup-error and cli-error-handling test suites validate graceful handling of rule loading failures, including placeholder rule behavior and non-zero CLI exit with clear errors.
- TypeScript & Test Setup (REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP): - package.json plus the passing Jest suites demonstrate a working TypeScript build and comprehensive Jest-based test infrastructure for the plugin.
- Documentation & User Experience: - README.md, user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md, and docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md all exist as referenced in the story, covering installation, ESLint v9 setup, plugin meta, and rule development. Combined with the green test suites, this satisfies the Quality Standards, Integration, User Experience, and Documentation acceptance criteria.
Given the up-to-date story text, existing implementation, and passing targeted and full test runs, this story is fully satisfied.
